description: A national-scale and fine-grained labeled dataset of centralized photovoltaic power plants with diverse scenarios across 28 provinces in China is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors wenmin qin, Xiaoqin Tang. The constructed dataset provides component-level photovoltaic identification across 28 key provinces in China, using Google remote sensing imagery at a 0.3-metre resolution. It covers diverse landscapes typical of solar energy applications, ranging from flatlands and highlands to wastelands and hilly regions. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 21224 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
